connectors.name: HiAnimeTV (BETA - Testing only)
connectors.releaseNotes: Candidate 1.0.1 for Aroki 2.0.3+ testing. Extracts mp4 streams from Blogger / GoogleVideo sources via scriptAssignment on fileUrl. Note: Titles using encrypted MegaPlay (source=hianime) or MegaVid (source=embed) fail resolution natively. On physical iOS devices, GoogleVideo streams may encounter 403 Forbidden due to mediaserverd User-Agent stripping of eaua tokens or IP locking.
